grok._note: Grok validates its OIDC session locally and rejects any placeholder (measured). Fallback tier: the access token is written into the sandbox (refresh stripped), --unshare-net and the broker's path/model/ceiling retained. Proven live 2026-08-18.

codex._note: ChatGPT subscription. MEASURED: inference is POST /responses, but only after supports_websockets=false -- by default Codex uses wss://api.openai.com/v1/responses which ignores the redirect and no HTTP broker can proxy. ChatGPT-Account-ID is derived from the token and is injected by the broker. The plugin/model GETs are allowlisted because denying them sent the CLI into a 647-request retry loop.

claude._note: Claude subscription OAuth. Token goes in ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN -> Authorization: Bearer (measured); ANTHROPIC_API_KEY would select the BYOK x-api-key path instead. Claude posts to /v1/messages?beta=true, so the broker matches the path component and ignores the query.

_note: This registry is CONTROLLER-OWNED and is the only source of model family /
vendor identity. A project profile may name ids from here; it can never
declare a family, because that would let a profile manufacture reviewer
It no longer tries to LIST every model. Versions churn weekly (`opencode
models` reports 26 ids where this file once hand-listed 18 across every
provider), so identity is DERIVED by controller-owned rules in registry.py:
family from the id stem, vendor from the provider for single-vendor CLIs, an
explicit vendor segment in the id, or the FAMILY_VENDOR table -- which is the
slowest-moving fact available, since a family's owner essentially never
changes. Every record carries identity_source so a derived classification can
be told from a curated one.
Entries below are OVERRIDES, kept for cases the rules would get wrong, plus
the provider records (upstream, credential class, allowed paths) which are
genuinely per-provider configuration and not derivable.
`ai-opencode models --live` asks each installed CLI what it can actually
serve today; that is availability, which this file deliberately does not claim.
Measured availability on opencode-go (2026-08-18): deepseek-v4-flash ok,
deepseek-v4-pro ok, kimi-k3 ok, qwen3.8-max flaky, glm-5.3 fails upstream.
